core_obligations: Quote the base change result for the implication from the vanishing of the ideal (proof line 4524).
Write the target as a directed colimit of local subalgebras essentially of finite type over the base (proof lines 4526-4532).
Use the limit-preserving result to move the condition to one subalgebra (proof lines 4533-4535).
Apply the finite type characterisation and conclude that the ideal dies in the target (proof lines 4536-4540).
proof_roadmap: Colimit presentation of the target (proof lines 4526-4535).
difficulty_reason: The lemma upgrades the characterisation of the flattening ideal to a universal property when the algebra is of finite type over the Noetherian base: a local base change satisfies the flat-at-primes condition exactly when the flattening ideal dies. One implication is quoted from the base change result for that condition. For the other, the author writes the Noetherian target as a directed colimit of local subalgebras essentially of finite type over the base, uses the limit-preserving result to move the flat-at-primes condition down to one of those subalgebras, applies the finite type version of the characterisation to that subalgebra, and concludes that the flattening ideal already dies there, hence also in the target.
